readiness.hed: Fredericksburg clears to a mild, mostly sunny 72 today after morning fog, turns colder and sunny Tuesday with a high near 54 and overnight low around 28, then climbs back to the mid-50s Wednesday before rain moves back in Wednesday night ahead of a wet Thanksgiving
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this morning. Today brings patchy fog before 9 a.m. clearing to mostly sunny skies with a high near 72, falling back to the mid-60s by afternoon. A cold front drops temperatures sharply for Tuesday — sunny with a high near 54 and an overnight low around 28, the week's coldest night so far — before a milder, partly sunny Wednesday near 55 gives way to an 80 percent chance of rain Wednesday night as a wetter pattern builds in. NWS's extended outlook points toward rain continuing into Thanksgiving Thursday with a high near 62.
actions: Tuesday's overnight low near 28 is the week's hardest freeze yet — bring in sensitive plants, cover outdoor spigots, and check on elderly neighbors before Tuesday night.
Today's morning fog should clear by 9 a.m., but give the early commute extra following distance and headlights until it lifts.
Wednesday night's rain arriving ahead of Thanksgiving means outdoor travel prep, grocery runs, and any yard work are best finished by Wednesday afternoon.
With rain likely continuing into Thanksgiving Day itself, plan any outdoor gathering elements — parking, decorations, a turkey fryer — with a wet-weather backup.
